prerequisites: It has a basic knowledge of manufacturing in machining
He has skills in measurement methods, techniques for measuring and evaluating the results of measurement
Can obtain information from literature, databases and other sources, and to draw conclusions and formulate and justify opinions

learning_outcomes.text: Student is able to correctly classify cutting tools, know their structure and geometry in different frames of reference.
Student can choose the modern technological processes cutting tools due to the efficiency and cost of production.
The student is able to explain the physical and chemical phenomena occurring at the cutting edge during machining.
Students can choose the tool materials due to optimal cutting for various workpiece materials.
Student can determine what is the influence of cutting edge geometry on the effects of machining technology.
Students should be able to use the computer programs used for the selection of tools set machining conditions.
Is aware of the importance of behavior in a professional way, well-defined and resolve dilemmas.
Recognize the effects of the impact of technology on the environment and related social responsibility of science and technology.
Is aware of the necessity of individual and group activities that go beyond the activities of engineering.

syllabus_topics: The role of tools and equipment in the production of machine parts
The geometry of the cutting edge. Reference systems and dimensioning of the blade. The role and importance of the angles of the blades in the cutting process.
Components of tools - construction and their functions
Cutters and cutter heads. Thread Tools and gears
Measurement and tool setting in flexible production system
Cutting tool geometry on technological effect of machining.
The choice of cutting tools with the use of computer programs
teaching_methods: traditional lecture with the use of transparencies and slides
self study - preparation for laboratory class
self study - self studies and preparation for examination
assessment_rules: For the lecture component, the final grade (P) is equal to the colloquium grade (F1). For the laboratory component, the final grade (P) is equal to the report on laboratory exercises grade (F1).
